correctness.rationale: All 2940 nonempty faces enumerated from the definition; 1424 exact matched pairs verified acyclic on all 2940 Hasse vertices. The only nonzero signed Morse map C4 to C3 has seven integral unit invariant factors and zero remainder; C5 to C4 is zero. After cell cancellation, the possible 5-cell Hopf elements are ruled out by exact zero Sq^2 on fifteen linearly independent H^3(F2) generators; homotopy wedge follows. Standalone source and saved terminal marker available.
